about: Long-sleeve tee (every Long-sleeve tee tile, flag lsTee: Athletics and the others; MODELQ8 2026-11-25, item 176): Tripo model long-sleeve-t-textured.glb (shape only; replaces the first long-sleeve tee model, deleted), the print all over (its parts file splits the neck band unevenly: no parts, so no ragged edges), printed through the made compression top's long-sleeve pattern. Look from the cards 10730 front / 10732 back: golden yellow all over its neck band in the same yellow (part of the print); our 3DEEZI marks in near-black (the card's own text and art not copied). First version (models live first).
